appearances.newly_possible: You can make a push to prod pause on a questionnaire that checks you understand the code your agent wrote.
appearances.why: It adds a human comprehension check to agent workflows without replacing code review.
appearances.limits: Does not prove a passed quiz means the code is correct or that the developer truly understands it.
